handoff_C06_to_C07.rule: Read exact local source text and map original identifiers to files, implementation and evidence; do not infer the contents from this plan.

semantics.requires: Usable verified local handoff required for dependent implementation. Real accepted local progress is reused.
semantics.integration_requires: Delta preparation may proceed earlier; accepting final consumer behavior requires the listed implementations and evidence.
semantics.product_acceptance_requires: A missing external condition may allow an explicitly partial engineering artifact, never a claim of real product acceptance.
semantics.inherited_acceptance: Preserve previous CP1 and its candidate identity; verify only changed or newly integrated behavior without hiding regressions.

invariants: No guess replaces the four actual C06 handoff items.
C07 and C08 serialize changes to scheduler_core.
C10 can start after recovery without waiting for C08.
C09 and C11 retain their accepted card records; their deltas do not increase the original 14-card count.
Only the coordinator changes shared types, generated files, refs or pushes.
Real product evidence, keyless integration, mock tests, CI and formal review are reported separately.
C07 acceptance is not a request for the user to issue another micro-task prompt.
The original A01-A24 and J1-J3 acceptance criteria remain mandatory under their existing definitions.
